standin.task.1.text: Three crystals and four more. How many crystals?
standin.task.1.twin.text: Two mushrooms and six more. How many mushrooms?
standin.task.1.hint.1: Something is being added here. Which total fits?
standin.task.1.hint.2: Start from the bigger number and count on.
standin.task.1.hint.3: Add one at a time until the second lot runs out.
standin.task.1.explanation: When more things are added to some things, you add the numbers. It helps to start from the bigger number and count on as many times as you added.
standin.task.2.text: The door has five locks, and two are already open. How many are left?
standin.task.2.twin.text: There are six scrolls on the shelf, and four were carried off. How many are left?
standin.task.2.hint.1: Part of them has gone. Which total fits?
standin.task.2.hint.2: Take away the part that has gone from the whole.
standin.task.2.hint.3: Count back from the whole, one at a time.
standin.task.2.explanation: When a part is taken from the whole, you find what is left by taking away: from the whole, you subtract the part that is no longer there.
standin.task.3.text: Two bridges with six planks each. How many planks altogether?
standin.task.3.twin.text: Three towers with five windows each. How many windows altogether?
standin.task.3.hint.1: There are several equal groups here. Which total fits?
standin.task.3.hint.2: How many groups, and how many in each?
standin.task.3.hint.3: Add one group again and again, as many times as there are groups.
standin.task.3.explanation: When there are several equal groups, you find the total by multiplying: the number in one group times the number of groups.
standin.scene.line.1: A little door glows at the foot of the tower. Nearby, the mist rustles softly.
standin.scene.line.2: A fluffy tail peeks out of the mist and waits to see what you decide.
standin.scene.branch.left: Go left, to the bright door
standin.scene.branch.right: Go right, along the quiet path
standin.ending.line.1: The mist over the path turns thick and warm. The tower is calling everyone home.
standin.ending.line.2: Everything you have stays with you. Tomorrow the tower will think up a new path.
battle.partial.1: The thread is almost in place.
battle.alt.1: The knot has loosened. The tower shows another way.
battle.alt.2: The path turns. The mist parts a little to the left.
system.fallback.line: Mist over the path. Wait a little.

ui.skills.marks.step.3: You read codes and catalogues freely and find the right drawer.

ui.skills.mechanics.step.3: You run and mend ordinary machines freely.
ui.skills.mechanics.step.4: You bypass a broken machine with a plan of your own.
ui.skills.mechanics.step.5: You mend a machine for someone else and build a new device from parts.

ui.skills.sharing.step.1: You divide a thing, through a check.
ui.skills.sharing.step.2: You notice that a share is unequal.
ui.skills.sharing.step.3: You divide fairly among familiars and townsfolk.
ui.skills.sharing.step.4: You find a division that leaves nobody aggrieved and settle a dispute.
ui.skills.sharing.step.5: You mediate other people's quarrels over shares.

ui.skills.precision.step.1: You measure finely, through a check.
ui.skills.precision.step.2: You notice a drop too much or too little.
ui.skills.precision.step.3: You set locks, doses and levels freely.
ui.skills.precision.step.4: You find the fine spot in a dam or a recipe.
ui.skills.precision.step.5: You teach others to measure and make exact things.
ui.skills.trade.name: Trade
ui.skills.trade.step.1: You judge a deal, through a check.
ui.skills.trade.step.2: You notice a deal tilted towards the other side.
ui.skills.trade.step.3: You trade and swap fairly, freely.
ui.skills.trade.step.4: You find the favourable swap at the Fair.
ui.skills.trade.step.5: You shield the unwary from a bad deal.
ui.skills.wayfinding.name: Wayfinding
ui.skills.wayfinding.step.1: You plan a route, through a check.
ui.skills.wayfinding.step.2: You notice a clock or a distance that does not add up.
ui.skills.wayfinding.step.3: You plan routes and arrival times freely.
ui.skills.wayfinding.step.4: You know a short way between floors.
ui.skills.wayfinding.step.5: You lead a group along a route.
ui.skills.shaping.name: Shaping

ui.skills.shaping.step.2: You notice a piece that does not fit.
ui.skills.shaping.step.3: You build, fold and fit freely, bridges and doors included.
ui.skills.shaping.step.4: You unfold a hidden room from its net.
ui.skills.shaping.step.5: You help others build and design a new structure.
ui.skills.scouting.name: Scouting

ui.skills.scouting.step.2: You notice a pattern or an odd one out.
ui.skills.scouting.step.3: You read tracks and patterns freely and spot what does not fit.
ui.skills.scouting.step.4: You foretell where a Tangle will appear.
ui.skills.scouting.step.5: You teach others to see patterns and read a bluff.
ui.skills.interpreting.name: Interpreting
ui.skills.interpreting.step.1: You understand a note, through a check.
ui.skills.interpreting.step.2: You notice what a text leaves out.
ui.skills.interpreting.step.3: You understand rumours, notes and contracts freely and speak with Guardians.
ui.skills.interpreting.step.4: You find in a text what others missed, a hidden clause or a missing number.
ui.skills.interpreting.step.5: You explain meanings to others and negotiate for them.
